battle.name: 趙萬海起義
battle.brief: 大業十二年八月乙巳，賊帥趙萬海眾數十萬自恆山出，寇高陽，河北亂局由雁門之圍後的募兵與饑荒推向失控。卡面羅馬投石機未在場，但它所屬的配重擲石機譜系，正是河北義軍攻城所倚重的石砲、撞車與雲梯所處的器械世界。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 這場衝突是隋朝末年河北恆山郡與河間郡高陽縣一帶的武裝起事，發生在隋煬帝大業十二年（616）八月。史籍對它只有一句記載：《隋書·煬帝紀》記「八月乙巳，賊帥趙萬海眾數十萬自恆山寇高陽」，《資治通鑑》卷一百八十三同繫此事。朝廷一方是隋朝中央與河間郡的官署：行軍尚書、行軍長史以下各府縣分守，郡丞主縣務、郡尉掌兵，郡兵之外另有鄉兵與屯田客，這些武裝是關防的唯一依賴；起事一方則是聚眾而成的武裝集團，趙萬海以賊帥自居，眾數十萬，出恆山而寇高陽。河北同時並起的武裝還有王須拔、魏刀兒、盧明月、朱粲、翟松柏各自成眾，關中則有樊子蓋奉詔討賊、經年不能剋的敬盤陀柴保昌；北面突厥自大業十一年秋雁門之圍後仍壓在塞上，隋廷兵力四面分散，至七月樊子蓋卒、十月宇文述薨，河北的官軍統制已近空虛。關於本役的原始記錄極為零散，可確定的只有上述時間、人物、眾數與兩個地名，雙方編制、兵員來源、攻城器械與戰果都沒有留下記載；本篇其餘部分都是依同年其他事件推得的背景，與推論一律在文中標明。
countriesEn: This conflict was an armed rising in the Hengshan Commandery and the neighbourhood of Gaoyang County in Hejian Commandery, in Hebei during the last years of the Sui, breaking out in the eighth month of the twelfth year of the Daye era (616). The historical sources record it in a single sentence: the Annals of Emperor Yang of Sui records it under the eighth month, on the day yisi, in the formula that the bandit leader Zhao Wanhai gathered several tens of thousands of men, came out from Hengshan and raided Gaoyang, and the Comprehensive Mirror, in volume 183, ties the same event to the same year. On the court side stood the Sui central government together with the offices of Hejian Commandery: below the Commissioner of the March and the Chief Administrative Officer of the March, the prefectures and counties each held their own ground, the Assistant Prefect of the Commandery handled county administration, the Commandery Guard Commander held the troops, and beyond the regular commandery soldiers there were local militia and garrison settlers — these armed bands were the only defensive resource available. The insurgents were a spontaneously gathered armed mass; Zhao Wanhai styled himself a bandit leader, raised several tens of thousands of men, came out of Hengshan and raided Gaoyang. Other armed groups rose at the same time in Hebei — Wang Xueba, Wei Daor, Lu Mingyue, Zhu Can and Zhai Songbai each gathering their own followers — while in the passes of Guanzhong Fan Zigai was still campaigning against the band of Jingbantuo and Chai Baochang, which he could not break in a year. To the north the Turks continued to press on the frontier after the siege of Yanmen in the autumn of the eleventh year of Daye, so the Sui forces were stretched in every direction; by the seventh month Fan Zigai died, in the tenth month Yuwen Shu died, and the military command structure in Hebei was close to hollow. The original record of this rising is extremely thin: what can be established is only the date, the person, the size of the host and the two place names. The formations on both sides, the source of the troops, the siege machines and the results were all left unrecorded. Everything else in this account is background inferred from other events of the same year, and every inference is marked as such in the text.
people: 本役唯一留下姓名的起事人物是趙萬海，史書稱他為「賊帥」，是當時河北大大小小武裝首領的通稱。他的出身未見記載，既不是隋廷將領，也不是地方郡吏，記錄裏只呈現一個聚合了數十萬眾、從恆山出擊高陽的首領形象。與他同時存在的是一批同類人物：大業十一年二月，上谷人王須拔反，自稱漫王，國號燕，魏刀兒自稱歷山飛，各擁眾十餘萬，北連突厥而南寇趙郡；七月淮南人張起緒舉兵為盜，眾至三萬；十月彭城人魏騏驎聚眾萬餘為盜，寇魯郡，盧明月眾十餘萬寇陳汝間，李子通渡淮自號楚王、建元明政而寇江都；十二月朱粲眾數十萬寇荊襄，僭稱楚帝、建元昌達。朝廷方面，七月樊子蓋卒——他是以關中兵討賊的主將，死後關中的追討之勢隨之渙散；十月宇文述薨，鎮北的宿將又少一人；十月隋煬帝病逝於江都，留下越王侗留守東都，江都另立新主，命令系統從此失序。河北後來由竇建德收拾局面：他自漳南起兵，據樂壽，617年已進取河間郡治安喜，618年稱帝，國號夏。趙萬海本人的結局、他的眾如何散去，兩部史書都沒有再提，這種沉默本身就是本役的結果。
peopleEn: The only named person on the insurgent side in this episode is Zhao Wanhai, whom the histories call a bandit leader, a generic title worn by the chiefs of the many armed bands in Hebei at that time. Nothing is recorded of his origins: he was neither a Sui general nor a local commandery official, and the sources present only a chief who had gathered several tens of thousands of men and struck out from Hengshan toward Gaoyang. Alongside him stood a company of similar figures. In the second month of the eleventh year of Daye, Wang Xueba of Shanggu rebelled, proclaiming himself Prince of Man and founding the state of Yan, while Wei Daor styled himself Flying of Lishan; each gathered more than a hundred thousand men, joining the Turks to the north and raiding Zhao Commandery to the south. In the seventh month Zhang Qixu of Huainan rose as a bandit with up to thirty thousand followers. In the tenth month Wei Qilin of Pengcheng collected more than ten thousand men and raided Lu Commandery; Lu Mingyue with over a hundred thousand raided the Chen and Ru districts; Li Zitong crossed the Huai, proclaimed himself King of Chu, set the era Mingzheng, and raided Jiangdu. In the twelfth month Zhu Can with several tens of thousands raided Jing and Xiang, usurping the title Emperor of Chu and setting the era Changda. On the court side, Fan Zigai died in the seventh month — he had led the troops from Guanzhong against the rebels, and with his death the pursuit from the passes fell apart; Yuwen Shu died in the tenth month, removing another of the veteran commanders holding the north; in the same tenth month Emperor Yang of Sui fell ill and died at Jiangdu, leaving Prince Yue Tong to hold the eastern capital while a new ruler was set up at Jiangdu, and the chain of command broke down from that point. Hebei was later gathered up by Dou Jiande, who rose from Zhangnan, made Leshou his base, took the commandery seat of Hejian at Anxi in 617, and proclaimed himself emperor with the title Xia in 618. As for Zhao Wanhai's own end and the dispersal of his followers, neither history says another word; that silence is itself the outcome of this episode.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬投石機並不屬於616年河北的裝備，它是西元前250年前後羅馬城邦用於圍城的單臂擲石機：以木構機架固定在底座上，長臂架在配重之上，發射時靠配重下沉把石彈拋向城牆，專打城頭守軍、塔樓與城門上方，用以在強攻前先削薄防禦。但它所對應的器械譜系在同時的中國完全存在，而且正是這場衝突裡攻城一方所倚重的東西。隋代攻城用的拋石車，漢魏史書稱「石砲」「霹靂車」，形制與onager同屬以配重換取射程的擲石機，架在牛車或木架上，發射前以人力與畜力拉緊機括，拋出數十至百餘斤的巨石，專打城頭女牆與密集之敵。以石為彈的好處是就地取材、反覆可射，與羅馬砲以陶製圓彈的做法路子相近，正合乎鄉民武裝缺乏繳獲、又沒有攻城專門器具的實況。除拋石之外，隋代攻城還備有撞車、穴車、雲梯、巢車、飛石、蒙革的破障車與火油火箭；守城一方倚城頭檑木礌石、手投礟石，並以臂弩、床弩、天子弩等強弩封鎖城門與壕溝。兵員裝備以明光鎧、兜鍪、長柄大刀、直刀、馬槊、皮盾為主，河北一帶騎兵多有馬具齊備者；戰馬、牛車與糧車構成後勤主力，起義軍多靠就地徵發糧秣與取用官倉器械維繫。
kitsEn: The Roman onager shown on the card was not equipment in use in Hebei in 616. It is the single-armed stone thrower used by the Roman republic in siege operations from around 250 BC: a wooden frame fixed to a base, a long arm rested upon a counterweight, and on firing the fall of the counterweight that throws the stone against the curtain wall, aimed at the defenders on the parapet, at towers and at the space above the gates, so as to thin the defences before an assault. The lineage of the machine, however, existed in China in the same period in full, and it is exactly what the besieging side in this episode relied on. The stone-throwing cart of the Sui siege train, called a stone catapult or a thunder-thrower in Han and Wei histories, belongs to the same family as the onager: a weight-driven stone thrower mounted on an ox-cart or timber frame, wound up by men and draught animals before firing and hurling stones of tens to more than a hundred catties, aimed at the parapet and at massed enemies. The advantage of stone as the missile is that it can be gathered on the spot and fired again and again, much as Roman artillery worked with its round shot, and it suited the actual circumstances of a band of villagers with few captured stores and no specialist siege gear. Beside the stone throwers, the Sui siege train included battering rams, burrowing carts, scaling ladders, tower carts, hand-thrown stones, hide-covered assault vehicles, and fire-arrows tipped with burning oil. The defenders relied on logs and rocks dropped from the parapet, on hand-thrown stones, and on arm crossbows, bed crossbows and heavy crossbows that sealed the gates and the ditch. On the soldiers' side the main items were bright-armour cuirasses, helmets, long-handled sabres, straight swords, cavalry lances and leather shields, and the horsemen of Hebei were for the most part well mounted. Warhorses, ox-carts and grain wagons formed the logistical backbone, and the insurgents kept themselves going largely by requisitioning grain locally and by taking the stores of the official granaries.
tactics: 從一句記載能推出來的戰術有限，但可以確定的起手式很清楚：大業十一年秋，隋煬帝在雁門被突厥圍困，城中兵民十五萬口、食僅可支二旬，詔天下募兵，河北各郡的郡兵鄉兵於是大量流散，器械散落鄉里，糧價騰貴，人相食的記載在江淮與河北同時出現——趙萬海在這樣的背景下於恆山聚起數十萬眾，說明他早已有了可以裹挾人口的鄉里網絡與地方關係。鄉民武裝攻城的老規矩是先期埋伏、晝夜兼行、以奇兵貼城：一路自恆山沿平原地帶向東推進至河間高陽，一路在鄉里分頭徵集糧秣與器械，約期在城下會合。攻城序列與官軍同時代的做法一致：拋石先行，置於城外安全距離，掩護撞車抵門、穴車掘進、雲梯靠牆，步兵以蒙革的車為掩蔽，分番更替，白日進逼、夜間襲營。守城方倚城頭高處施檑木礌石，招募鄉勇輪番執飛石投擲，強弩封住城門與壕溝，把重點放在遲滯進攻者的衝鋒，不在城門洞開之際被一次突破。河北一帶多騎兵，鄉民軍若無騎兵可用，靠的就是器械與夜襲取長補短。補給線是這支部眾最脆弱的一環：糧食全賴鄉里就地搜括，遇上饑年只能流動求生；隋軍則倚江都、洛陽輻輳，遠道運糧極難，一旦郡兵被圍而援兵不至，守城一方往往先耗盡。
tacticsEn: Only limited tactics can be drawn from a single recorded sentence, but the opening is clear. In the autumn of the eleventh year of Daye Emperor Yang of Sui was shut up at Yanmen by the Turks, with a hundred and fifty thousand soldiers and civilians in the city and food for no more than twenty days; the edict summoning troops from all the provinces followed, and the commandery soldiers and village militia of Hebei scattered in great numbers, their equipment left among the villages, while grain prices soared and the records of people eating one another appear for both the Jianghuai and Hebei. For Zhao Wanhai to gather several tens of thousands at Hengshan in such circumstances means he already had the network of village ties and local relationships needed to sweep people up. The old practice of a village rising in a siege is to lie in ambush beforehand, move by night and day alike, and press close to the walls with picked troops: one body would push east from Hengshan across the plain toward Gaoyang in Hejian, while others gathered grain and equipment in the villages, due to meet below the city. The order of assault matched the practice of the time on the government side as well: stone throwers first, sited at a safe distance outside the walls, covering the rams driven against the gate, the burrowing carts sent in under the wall and the scaling ladders brought up, with infantry advancing behind hide-covered carts, reliefs taking turns, pressing forward by day and raiding the camp by night. The defenders used the height of the rampart to drop logs and rocks, enrolled local braves to take turns hurling stones, and sealed the gates and ditch with crossbows, concentrating on blunting the momentum of the attackers rather than risking a single breakthrough while the gate stood open. Hebei had many horsemen; where a band of villagers had none, siege machines and night attacks were what made up the difference. Supply was the weakest link in such a host: food came entirely from foraging the countryside, and in a lean year the band had to keep moving to survive. Sui troops, by contrast, drew on Jiangdu and Luoyang, and long-distance grain supply was extremely difficult; once a commandery garrison was surrounded with no relieving force coming, the defenders of the city were usually the first to be exhausted.
data: 關於數字，可靠的只有幾組。起事本體：《隋書·煬帝紀》記大業十二年（616）八月乙巳「賊帥趙萬海眾數十萬自恆山寇高陽」，《資治通鑑》卷一百八十三同繫此事——「數十萬」是史書的概數，不宜當作點名冊看待。地理：隋恆山郡治恆山縣（今河北曲陽一帶），河間郡高陽縣（今河北保定高陽），兩地相距直線約一百公里，義軍由西向東推進。人口背景：《隋書·地理志》記隋朝鼎盛時全州郡合計戶八百九十餘萬、丁四百六十餘萬；經三征高句麗與關內大旱，到大業末年只剩一半上下。饑荒程度：江淮之間米價飛騰，饑民採橡實與樹皮，史書甚至記有人相食。相關的時間點也清楚：大業十一年（615）八月乙丑隋煬帝巡北塞，突厥始畢可汗率騎數十萬謀襲乘輿，壬申車駕馳入雁門，癸酉被圍，城中兵民十五萬口、食僅可支二旬、突厥克雁門四十一城之三十九，甲申詔天下募兵，九月甲辰解圍；大業十二年七月樊子蓋卒、十月宇文述薨、十月煬帝病逝江都；十三年竇建德進取河間郡治安喜；618年竇建德稱帝於樂壽；621年五月虎牢關李世民破竇建德前鋒、夜襲牛口渚，竇建德被俘，河北遂定。趙萬海部的確切人數、所部編制與雙方死傷，兩部史書都無記載，只能作罷。
dataEn: As to figures, only a few groups are reliable. The rising itself: the Annals of Emperor Yang of Sui places it in the eighth month of the twelfth year of Daye (616), on the day yisi, under the formula that the bandit leader Zhao Wanhai gathered several tens of thousands of men, came out from Hengshan and raided Gaoyang, and the Comprehensive Mirror, in volume 183, ties the same event to the same year — The phrase several tens of thousands is a historian's round figure and should not be read as a roll of names. Geography: the Sui commandery of Hengshan had its seat at Hengshan County, in what is now the Quyang area of Hebei, while Gaoyang County in Hejian Commandery corresponds to Gaoyang near Baoding in modern Hebei; the two lie roughly a hundred kilometres apart in a straight line, and the insurgents moved from west to east. On population: the Geography Treatise of the History of Sui records that at the height of the Sui, all the provinces and commanderies together had a little over 8.9 million households and some 4.6 million able-bodied men; after three campaigns against Goguryeo and the great drought in the passes, barely half of that remained by the end of the Daye era. On the depth of the famine: the price of rice in the Jianghuai region rocketed, the hungry ate acorns and bark, and the histories even record people eating one another. The surrounding chronology is equally clear. In the eighth month of the eleventh year of Daye (615), on the day yichou, Emperor Yang of Sui toured the northern frontier; the Türgesh qaghan Bibidie led tens of thousands of horsemen to strike at the emperor's train; on the day renshen the imperial carriage fled into Yanmen, where it was besieged on the following day, guisui: a hundred and fifty thousand soldiers and civilians were inside, food would last no more than twenty days, and the Turks took thirty-nine of the forty-one cities of Yanmen; on the day jiashen an edict summoned troops from all the provinces, and on the day jiachen in the ninth month the siege was lifted. In the seventh month of the twelfth year Fan Zigai died; in the tenth month Yuwen Shu died; in that same tenth month Emperor Yang fell ill and died at Jiangdu. In the thirteenth year Dou Jiande took the commandery seat of Hejian at Anxi. In 618 Dou Jiande proclaimed himself emperor at Leshou; in the fifth month of 621, at Hulao, Li Shimin broke Dou Jiande's vanguard and struck at Niukou by night, taking Dou Jiande prisoner, and Hebei was settled. There is no record in either history of the exact numbers of Zhao Wanhai's men, of the organisation of his force, or of losses on either side; those must simply be left open.
cause: 起事的第一層原因是國家已經轉不動了。大業年間三次征高句麗，役夫與戰兵一役接一役地被抽往遼東，河北與山東丁壯大量外流，農事失耕；其後江淮大旱、漕運又被戰事與徵集切斷，糧價一漲再漲，郡縣倉庫空了，饑民成群結隊離鄉。第二層原因是中央權威離地方太遠：煬帝的行在在涿郡、雁門與江都之間巡行，帶走精銳宿衛，留守各郡的多是老弱，郡丞一級的官員實際上獨負一方軍政。第三層原因是軍隊已經解體，而且是被自己的皇帝解體的：大業十一年八月雁門之圍，城中食僅可支二旬，突厥攻破雁門四十一城中的三十九，詔天下募兵之後，各郡郡兵大批西調、潰散與逃亡，逃兵、降卒與被解散的役夫散在鄉里，手中仍有器械與技藝，只要有人出面號召，一夜之間便可成軍。趙萬海能在恆山聚起數十萬眾，靠的就是這一層：鄉里之間的生存網絡、血族與姻親的號召，以及散落各處的軍械流寇。河北同時段還有十幾支同類武裝，隋廷根本沒有足夠的兵員同時應付。第四層原因是北方的壓力沒有解除，突厥自大業十一年秋之後仍在塞外活動，使河北既不能休養也不能增兵，盜賊得以在兩股勢力之間的空隙裡坐大。至於趙萬海起義是否另有個人層面的原因，兩部史書都沒有留下線索，本篇不作推測。
causeEn: The first layer of cause is that the state had stopped working. Through the years of Daye the Sui campaigned against Goguryeo three times, and labour and soldiers were drawn off to Liaodong campaign after campaign; the able-bodied men of Hebei and Shandong left in great numbers and the fields went untilled. Then a great drought struck the Jianghuai, the canal transport was cut by the wars and by fresh levies, the price of grain rose again and again, the granaries of the commanderies and counties stood empty, and the hungry left their homes in bands. The second layer is that central authority stood geographically too far from the localities: the emperor's travelling seat moved between Zhuojun, Yanmen and Jiangdu, taking the elite guards with it, while the commanderies were left with the old and the weak, so an official of the rank of Assistant Prefect in practice bore the whole military burden of his district alone. The third layer is that the army had come apart, and that it was the emperor himself who had come apart. In the eighth month of the eleventh year of Daye, at the siege of Yanmen, food inside the city would last no more than twenty days and the Turks took thirty-nine of the city's forty-one subordinate towns; after the edict summoning troops from all the provinces, the commandery soldiers were marched west in great numbers, scattered and turned into deserters, and the runaway soldiers, the surrendered men and the discharged conscripts scattered across the countryside still had their weapons and their training — once someone called them together, an armed force could exist overnight. Zhao Wanhai's ability to gather several tens of thousands at Hengshan rested precisely on this: the web of survival between villages, the call of blood and marriage, and the loose military material lying about the country. A dozen comparable bands were operating in Hebei at the same time, and the Sui court simply did not have the men to deal with all of them. The fourth layer is that the pressure from the north was never lifted: the Turks remained active beyond the frontier after the autumn of the eleventh year of Daye, so Hebei could neither rest nor be reinforced, and the bandits grew fat in the gap between the two powers. As for whether Zhao Wanhai's rising had any personal cause behind it, neither history leaves a trace, and this account draws no inference.
impact: 對河北而言，這場起義是一次地方秩序崩解的實測。隋廷在雁門被圍時已不得不詔天下募兵，等到募兵之後的潰散與逃亡遇上饑荒，郡兵這支唯一有組織的武裝就化成了各路盜賊的兵源；趙萬海眾數十萬自恆山寇高陽，說明在兩年之內，一縣一郡的防務就可以被地方武裝接管，正面官軍的戰力反而不如鄉民結幫的效率。河北此後成為群雄逐鹿的戰場：大業十三年竇建德聯軍攻取河間郡治安喜，618年竇建德稱帝於樂壽、國號夏，李密在洛口倉另建魏國，618年宇文化及弒逆於江都，隋室在趙萬海舉兵之後兩三年之間名存實亡。河北的鄉兵與郡兵在隋末普遍被各類武裝吸收，唐朝平定河北後收其精銳充入禁軍與邊軍，使這批原屬地方州郡的武力改隸中央，成為唐初軍制的底子之一。在器械史上，拋石車這類以配重換取射程的重型攻城器械，在隋末群雄爭奪城邑時已被普遍配備，攻城從此更多倚重器械破壞而非單純蟻附；羅馬onager所代表的擲石機譜系，在中國這一時期正是以「砲」與「車」的名義延續下來。
impactEn: For Hebei this rising was a practical demonstration that the local order had come apart. By the time of the siege of Yanmen the Sui court had already been forced to summon troops from all the provinces; when the subsequent dispersal and desertion of those levies met the famine, the commandery soldiers — the one organised armed body in the region — turned into the manning pool for the bandits. That Zhao Wanhai could bring several tens of thousands out of Hengshan to raid Gaoyang shows that within two years the defence of a single county or commandery could be taken over by local armed groups, and that the fighting quality of the regular government troops was now inferior to that of villagers banded together. Hebei became the ground on which the rival powers fought: in the thirteenth year of Daye Dou Jiande's coalition took the commandery seat of Hejian at Anxi; in 618 Dou Jiande proclaimed himself emperor at Leshou with the title Xia, while Li Mi built the state of Wei out of the granary at Luokou; in 618 Yuwen Huaji committed the coup at Jiangdu, so that within two or three years of Zhao Wanhai's raising of troops the Sui house was a name and nothing more. The village militia and commandery soldiers of Hebei were absorbed in large numbers by every kind of armed band in the late Sui; after Tang had pacified Hebei it took the picked men of these forces into the imperial guard and the frontier armies, so that military strength formerly belonging to the local commanderies passed under central control and became one of the foundations of early Tang military organisation. In the history of siegecraft, heavy machines like the stone thrower, which bought range through counterweight, were in general issue among the contending warlords of the late Sui as they fought for walled cities, and assaults came to rely more on the destruction wrought by machines than on men simply scaling the walls; the lineage of the stone thrower that the Roman onager represents continued in China at this time precisely under the names of the catapult and the siege cart.
result: 就本役的過程而言，結果只有一句話：趙萬海的眾在616年八月確實自恆山出、寇高陽，規模達史書所稱的數十萬，除此之外，兩部史書都沒有再寫過他。這種沉默本身要如實交代，不能替史書補結局。《隋書·煬帝紀》與《資治通鑑》卷一百八十三在記完「眾數十萬自恆山寇高陽」之後，注意力就轉到同年九月陳稜破杜揚州沈覔敵、十月宇文述薨、十二月林士弘以太平年號陷九江廬陵、唐公破甄翟兒於西河等事，再沒有追問河北這支數十萬之眾的下落。由可以確定的旁證推斷，河北在616年後逐步落入竇建德的勢力範圍：617年竇建德聯軍攻取河間郡治安喜，618年在樂壽稱帝建夏，621年五月虎牢關被李世民擊敗、軍潰被俘，河北遂入於唐。但趙萬海本人及其部眾是否曾在竇建德的聯軍之中、是否被平、被招安或自行散去，史料一概不載，本篇只把這一層標為推論。可確定的結果是：一場規模在史書看來極大的武裝起事，在正史裏只佔一行記載；它既沒有像竇建德那樣建國立號，也沒有留下可查的戰役記錄，唯一留下來的痕跡，是隋朝末年河北的地方武裝已經能夠成建制地活動這一點。
resultEn: As to the course of this rising, the result amounts to a single sentence: Zhao Wanhai's host in the eighth month of 616 did come out of Hengshan and raid Gaoyang, at a size the histories put at several tens of thousands; beyond that, neither history writes of him again. That silence must be reported honestly rather than papered over with an invented ending. After recording that several tens of thousands came out of Hengshan and raided Gaoyang, the Annals of Emperor Yang of Sui and the Comprehensive Mirror in volume 183 turn to other matters — in the ninth month Chen Leng defeats Shen Midi of Duyangzhou, in the tenth month Yuwen Shu dies, in the twelfth month Lin Shihong, using the era Taiping, takes Jiujiang and Luling while the Duke of Tang breaks Zhai Zhier at the Xihe — and never ask again what became of the several tens of thousands in Hebei. From collateral evidence that can be established, Hebei passed gradually after 616 into the sphere of Dou Jiande: in 617 Dou's coalition took the commandery seat of Hejian at Anxi; in 618 he proclaimed himself emperor at Leshou and founded Xia; in the fifth month of 621 he was defeated by Li Shimin at Hulao, his army broke and he was taken; and Hebei fell to the Tang. Whether Zhao Wanhai himself and his men ever entered Dou Jiande's coalition, and whether they were suppressed, absorbed or dispersed on their own, is not recorded at all, and this account marks that layer as inference only. What can be established is this: a rising of a scale the histories treat as enormous occupies a single line in the official record. It founded no state and proclaimed no era, and it left no trace of any battle, and the one thing it did leave behind was proof that by the end of the Sui the local armed groups of Hebei were already capable of operating as formed bodies.
